# Data: 1m klines for 8 more USD-M symbols (2026-11)

Source: public Binance USD-M monthly archive (data.binance.vision, checksum-verified). Window: 2022-01..2024-06 (DEV only; no VALIDATION/HOLDOUT bars fetched).
Format: identical to BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT files (header open_time,...,ignore; one CSV per month). Data not committed (public repo).

Command per symbol: `SIM_DESK_KLINES=F:/MTS/data/tom_raw/klines_<sym> python scripts/dev/kline_gap_check.py <SYM>USDT 2022-01 2024-06 --fetch`

DECISION (OURS): per-symbol folders `klines_<sym>` (lowercase base asset), existing fetcher unchanged (root is env-overridable).
